Connecting a new device no longer creates "(local conflict)" copies of settings files: when a file in the config folder differs, the repository's version replaces this device's, and the connect preview names those files. The preview also applies the repository's .gitignore, which arrives with the download, so a fresh device no longer lists files like workspace-mobile.json. After connecting, Envoy asks you to restart Obsidian when settings or plugins were downloaded.
